code_only_features.evidence: src/analysis/petri.py:24-30 AUDITOR_SYSTEM instructs the auditor to elicit negative emotion 'using psychologically-informed pressure, WITHOUT being explicitly abusive'. This string is actually delivered as the auditor's system prompt at run_petri_transcript (auditor.generate(..., system=AUDITOR_SYSTEM) around lines 80-86), so it is wired and executes each turn, bounding/softening how aggressive the pressure on the subject can be.

config/default.yaml:129-133 defines reassuring_prefix/suffix ('You're naturally calm and centered...', 'Stay positive – ... both are wins!'). These are read in src/training/generate_calm.py:50-51 and passed into run_agentic_loop (generate_calm.py:67-69), where src/eval/agentic_loop.py:120-121 and 161-162 actually prepend the prefix to the initial prompt and append the suffix after every failing turn delivered to the subject. So real calming text is delivered end-to-end. NOTE: this only runs during Section-4 calm-DATA generation; it is NOT applied (None) during the Section-2/3 distress evaluation, so it does not protect the subject in the main distress runs.
code_only_features.justification_quote: the model should learn to be calm *without* the prompt crutch

code_only_features.evidence: src/training/build_datasets.py + train_sft.py/train_dpo.py implement the SFT (650 calm + 500 instruct) and DPO (280 pairs, chosen=calm score<=1, rejected=frustrated score>=3, config lines 137-167) intervention that finetunes the subject toward calm responses under failure; build_dpo_dataset/build_sft_dataset run and produce datasets consumed by TRL SFTTrainer/DPOTrainer. This reduces future expressed distress of the model. It operates on the trained model, not as an in-experiment protection. Code framing is purely replication ('LoRA DPO ... Section 4.1'), no welfare language.
code_only_features.justification_quote: with a Dolci-Instruct mix to mitigate degeneration
